## Summary
- reject formal latency evidence packages that reuse the same retained file for multiple required evidence roles
- add a synchronized-clock regression test for combined input/synchronization artifacts

## Validation
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_latency_evidence -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_latency tools.tests.test_latency_manifest tools.tests.test_latency_preflight tools.tests.test_external_latency_current_base tools.tests.test_latency_evidence -v
- make evidence-latency-preflight (expected exit 2; repository remains blocked/readiness-only)

This is offline fail-closed hardening only and does not mark telemetry_and_latency_archive as passing.
title: Harden latency evidence artifact role validation
